notes.desc: 60 m hero section of the dam crest. Road along +Z (z 0..60) at y=0 (road_surface, x -7..7), balustrades, lamps, expansion joints; reservoir on -X (water_dark at y=-4), gravity-dam body drops 45 m on the downstream +X side (sloped face, base at y=-45), one spillway bay (z 22..38, 16 m) with a steel radial gate and a stepped chute; road crosses the bay on a girder deck over the piers (z 18..22, 38..42). Chain more `dam_road_10m` beyond z=0 / z=60 (same crest width). No terrain included: place terrain at y=-45 on the +X side.
